title: Handover Evidence and Transit Liability Figures — Northbeam Purchase Orders and Fulfilment
content:
How a handover on an order under Northbeam Purchase Orders and Fulfilment is evidenced, whether a signature is taken
at it, the order value at or above which identity is checked at handover, and the most the retailer meets for goods
lost on the way are all set by the fulfilment service the order was placed under. The confirmation basis is how the
handover is evidenced; the signature column states whether a signature is taken at handover; the identity figure is
the order value at or above which identity is checked at handover; and the transit liability figure is the most the
retailer meets for goods lost on the way.

| Fulfilment service | How the handover is evidenced | Signature taken | Identity checked at an order value of | Most met for goods lost on the way |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Standard Parcel Delivery | photograph at the door | no | 999.00 | 1500.00 |
| Store Pickup Hold | counter receipt | yes | 499.00 | 0.00 |
| Threshold Delivery | signature | yes | 1999.00 | 5000.00 |
| Room of Choice Delivery with Haul Away | signature and photograph | yes | 1999.00 | 7500.00 |
| White Glove Delivery and Installation | signature, photograph and a completed checklist | yes | 2999.00 | 15000.00 |
| Business Dock and Freight Delivery | signed delivery note and pallet count | yes | 4999.00 | 50000.00 |

## The identity figure read on both sides (hypothetical order values)

The identity figure is an at-or-above figure. On Threshold Delivery, whose figure is 1999.00, an order value of
1998.99 stands below the figure while an order value of exactly 1999.00 stands at it. The lowest figure in the column
belongs to Store Pickup Hold, at 499.00, and the highest to Business Dock and Freight Delivery, at 4999.00.

## Notes on the evidence column

Only Standard Parcel Delivery is evidenced without a signature, by a photograph at the door. The collection service
is evidenced by a counter receipt and carries a transit liability figure of 0.00. The three two-person services and the freight service each add evidence to the signature: a
photograph, a completed checklist, or a pallet count on the delivery note.
